title: IG Introduces Zero-commission Crypto Trading for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana
author: Sigma Capital
metaDescription: IG now offers zero-commission trading for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana, making it one of the lowest-cost providers in the UK market for these cryptocurrencies.
excerpt: IG now offers zero-commission trading for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana, making it one of the lowest-cost providers in the UK market for these cryptocurrencies. Pricing for other cryptocurrencies remains at 1.49%. This change took effect on June 1, 2026.

body: Home » News » Crypto » IG Introduces Zero-commission Crypto Trading for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana. # IG Introduces Zero-commission Crypto Trading for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana. Share on LinkedIn Share on X (Twitter) Share on Facebook Share on Email Share on WhatsApp. Investing and trading platform IG today announces the launch of zero-commission trading on its three most popular cryptocurrencies – Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana – making IG one of the lowest-cost providers in the UK market for crypto. Now they can access the lowest-cost offering in the UK for Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana through a FTSE 100-listed platform.”. Pricing on other cryptocurrencies available on the IG platform remains unchanged, with a 1.49% fee applied when buying and selling.
